 R EMINDER   
If you are transferring plates to a new car,  we need your original registration. If you don't have it, it will cost $23 to replace.  
When paying any property or sewer bill,  the most helpful thing you can do is put the  BILL #  you are paying in the memo field of your check. 
Please take note:   Please give your checks a second look before submitting them. We are receiving a large number of miswritten or badly written checks. We scan & deposit the checks remotely.  Examples of what our scanner won't accept: 
Dollar amount does not match written amount. 
Missing signatures   
Anything but blue or black ink.  
When renewing your vehicle registration  online you need your renewal notice which has your pin in the upper right hand corner. For in person transactions, please bring your current registration or renewal notice along with your driver's license.   
Thank you!

Wetlands & Waterways Construction 
Those working in or near  
wetlands or waterways   must file a Dredge and Fill application with the State of NH before beginning work (RSA 483-A). Fines may be assessed for non-compliance. 
 Any questions should be referred to the New Hampshire Department of Environmental Services (DES), Wetlands Bureau. They may be reached at  
(603) 271-2147 or visit their  website  for more information.
